core_obligations: Use the section-level remark to obtain a canonical map L_{O_X(U)/f^{-1}O_Y(U)} -> L_{X/Y}(U), compatible with restrictions (proof lines 4142-4147).
Compose with the map induced by A -> f^{-1}O_Y(U) to get L_{B/A} -> L_{O_X(U)/f^{-1}O_Y(U)} (proof lines 4147-4150).
Apply the universal property of sheafification to produce the map of the statement (proof lines 4151-4153).
Check the map is an isomorphism on stalks using the stalk and localization lemmas for the cotangent complex and the description of the stalks of the two structure sheaves (proof lines 4154-4164).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism of schemes f : X -> Y and affine opens U = Spec(B) of X and V = Spec(A) of Y with f(U) contained in V, there is a canonical map from the sheafification of L_{B/A} to the restriction L_{X/Y}|_U which is an isomorphism in D(O_U), compatible with restricting to smaller affine opens (source lines 4129-4140). The proof builds the map in three steps: the canonical map of complexes from the ring-level complex of global sections L_{O_X(U)/f^{-1}O_Y(U)} to L_{X/Y}(U) taken from a chapter remark, then the canonical map L_{B/A} -> L_{O_X(U)/f^{-1}O_Y(U)} induced by A -> f^{-1}O_Y(U), and finally the universal property of the sheafification functor; the isomorphism is checked on stalks, where the description of the stalks of the two structure sheaves together with the stalk and localization lemmas for the cotangent complex give the result.
